label: sweep s16: 16 stage-B shards on one arm
notes: Desktop parallelism sweep, eval side. Identical work every wave — p2h's screen:97 set at 100 episodes — so wall clock is the shard-count comparison. Labelled and --no-resume so each config does the full set and none of them touches p2h's real stage-B file; the labelled outputs are throwaway. --no-window because a viewer costs a couple of percent of a core that would land in the number. SNEK_EVAL_WORKERS/SNEK_TORCH_THREADS cannot be set here: the daemon strips both from an eval wave (TRAINING_ONLY_KEYS), which is correct — they configure a training loop, not a measurement. 100 episodes not 500, to fit the hour.
